name: AWS WAF — WebACL, Rule, or IPSet Deleted
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = amazon_aws_raw
| filter xdm.event.type in ("DeleteWebACL","DisassociateWebACL","UpdateWebACL","DeleteRule","DeleteRuleGroup","DeleteIPSet","DeleteFirewallPolicy")
| bin _time span = 1h
| comp count() as events,
       values(xdm.source.user.username) as users,
       values(xdm.event.type) as operations,
       values(xdm.event.description) as events_seen
       by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, users, events_seen
description: DeleteWebACL, DisassociateWebACL, UpdateWebACL, DeleteRule, DeleteRuleGroup, DeleteIPSet, or DeleteFirewallPolicy event — inbound protection being removed.
alert_name: AWS WAF — WebACL, Rule, or IPSet Deleted

TA0005 - Defense Evasion: T1562.007 - Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Cloud Firewall
